jobs.title: Environmental Geologist or Scientist Mid-Level
jobs.description:
Tetra Tech is adding a Mid-Level Environmental Scientist or Geologist to our field team based in Germantown, Md, with field work locations primarily in Frederick, Carroll and Baltimore counties. This position requires the employee to be a U.S. Citizen due to the projects they will be working on.

Discover your full potential. At Tetra Tech, we are collaborating with industry-leading experts for a sustainable future for our world. We combine consulting and engineering with advanced analytics and technology to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our innovation hubs across the globe will enable you to share ideas and best practices while growing your professional network. Wherever you are in your career journey, you will benefit from working with world-class engineers, scientists, and technical specialists.

Apply today and join the company that is Leading with Science®.

Your Role

This position will provide mid-level geologist or scientist to support various environmental assessment/remediation projects. Work includes due diligence work, report preparation, and various environmental field work. Field work and travel is estimated to be 75%. Capable of assuming responsibility for routine to complex tasks/projects. Experience in leading field crews is desirable.

Assume lead and supporting technical role for projects.
Record field data, write reports, generate figures and tables, manage data.
Perform Phase I and II ESAs.
Conduct environmental due diligence and perform Investigations at CERCLA, RCRA, and other impacted sites.
Collect soil and water samples using various sampling techniques (soil, sediment, groundwater surface water, waste)
Plan and coordinate directly with subcontractors and field personnel.
Assume supporting roles in proposals and marketing.
Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
Other duties as be assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in geology or environmental science is required, Master’s degree (MS/MA) a plus, but not required.
3-5 years directly related professional experience and/or training in environmental assessment/remediation related work preferred
Stormwater pollution prevention compliance experience, a plus
Erosion and Sediment Control compliance inspection experience, a plus
Willingness and ability to perform field work at various locations, approximately 75%.
40-hour HazWoper Certification preferred. Ability to obtain certification within 90-days, required.

Background Check: If this position requires a CAC card, CUI Enclave Access and/or a Security Clearance, a background check will be completed.

Physical Demands:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The Physical Demands Of Field Activities Include

Sampling work may include lifting, maneuvering, positioning, and operating sampling/testing equipment (pumps, hoses, power cables, hand augers, sampling tools, etc.).
Operation of field equipment and movement over rough terrain.
Traversing and remaining motionless for long periods of time
Ability to lift up to 60 lbs

Work Environment:
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Project work will entail a mix of office work and field work. Office work will be in a typical office environment with controlled conditions. Field work will entail work in a wide range of outdoor conditions, including work in adverse weather conditions, such as high heat, extreme cold, and precipitation and on unimproved job sites where dense vegetation, uneven ground, and physical obstacles may be present. Project worksites will typically be within the eastern United States but may include travel to/work at sites across the United States and internationally. Field project durations may range from one day to several weeks.

Language & Communication Skills:
Instructions/Suggestions: You may want to include here the written and oral communication requirements; must be fluent in the English language – writing and speaking, etc.; Report writing requirements, etc.

Ability to read, research, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical documents and procedures, and government regulations. Ability to write detailed reports, business correspondence, and procedures suitable for client submittal. Ability to effectively present information, communicate, and respond to questions from groups of coworkers, clients, customers, and the public. Effective communication skills, both orally and in written form. Must be fluent in the English language – reading, writing, and speaking.

Other Skills

Ability to evaluate basic and complex issues, solve practical problems, and deal with a variety of concrete and abstract variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret and follow a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Strong technical, writing, and verbal communication skills required. General computer, word processing, and spreadsheet capabilities are required, along with experience with using Microsoft Office applications (WORD, EXCEL, PowerPoint, etc.). Knowledge/experience in computer-based, geosciences-related, graphics software, data evaluation software, electronic field data collection, and/or groundwater flow/contaminant transport modeling is desirable, but not necessary.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

Tetra Tech is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers. Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, culture, and opportunities:

LinkedIn: @TetraTechCareers

X (Twitter): @TetraTechJobs

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Please no phone calls or agencies.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team at Patrick Space Force Base, Florida. This position offers an exciting opportunity to support the Space Training and Readiness Command (STARCOM) by providing data analysis, reporting, and visualizations to improve operational effectiveness, and support mission success.

The Data Analyst will collect, analyze, and interpret data from multiple enterprise systems to develop workforce analysis, and support enterprise decisions making. The successful candidate will develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations that provide meaningful insights to government stakeholders. This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

The Data Analyst will

Develop and continuously enhance STARCOM's workforce analytics capabilities, providing timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
Analyze workforce, operational, and organizational data to identify trends, measure performance, and support planning efforts
Develop, maintain, and enhance executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using data from multiple enterprise systems
Design and implement automated reporting solutions, databases, and analytics tools to improve efficiency and data accessibility
Identify workforce trends, hiring metrics, readiness indicators, and organizational performance measures to inform leadership decisions
Collaborate with government stakeholders to gather requirements and develop reporting and analytical solutions
Respond to leadership and stakeholder requests by preparing timely, accurate reports, dashboards, and analytical products
Validate, integrate, cleanse, and standardize data from multiple sources to ensure data quality and consistency
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and recommend enhancements that increase efficiency
Prepare reports, presentations, and data visualizations that communicate analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Develop predictive models and trend analyses to support workforce planning, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making

Skills And Experience

The Data Analyst must have

Active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) security clearance
5+ years of experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) organizations in data analytics, business intelligence, workforce analytics, or a related field
Demonstrated experience collecting, integrating, cleansing, validating, and analyzing large datasets from multiple enterprise systems
Experience developing executive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, Excel, or similar business intelligence tools
Experience analyzing business processes, workforce data, and operational metrics to deliver actionable insights and recommendations
Experience collaborating with stakeholders to gather business requirements and develop data-driven analytical solutions
Experience implementing predictive analytics, forecasting models, and trend analysis to support strategic planning and organizational decision-making
Strong understanding of data quality management, governance, and data validation best practices
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, mission-focused environment

Education and Certifications

The Data Analyst must meet the following

Required

Bachelor of Art (BA) or Bachelor of Science (BS)
Equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of education

Benefits

Medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance
Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k)
PTO
Paid Paternal leave
Tuition reimbursement
Paid federal holidays

Security Clearance

Must be a U.S. Citizen. A high-level Department of Defense active security clearance is/may be required. Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to government information.

Physical Requirements

Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time and typing and reading from a computer screen. The candidate must have enough mobility, including bending, reaching, and kneeling, to complete daily duties in a prompt and efficient manner, and that may include lifting up to thirty pounds, as necessary.

Company Summary

Headquartered in Hawaii, Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC, is an SBA-Certified NHO-owned 8(a) Small Business specializing in global information technology solutions. We deliver professional services in IT Design & Installation, Cybersecurity Engineering & Support, Application Integration & Development, Software & Hardware Engineering, Network & Systems Management, Information Systems Security, and Business Management Services.

Leveraging over 30 years of providing IT services to the federal & commercial market with projects found around the world, our team has innovative expertise in the development of a wide range of technological solutions. Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

Our service commitment is simple - "Quality IT Solutions... On Time & On Budget."

Company Employment Statement

Galapagos Federal Systems, LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description does not all encompassing as positions, functions, and qualifications may vary depending on business needs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Safety Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Position Summary

Bengal is seeking an experienced Safety Compliance & Training Coordinator
to support employee onboarding, training, credential management, and workforce compliance.

This position works closely with Safety, Recruiting, Operations, Payroll, employees, and outside providers to ensure employees are properly screened, trained, documented, and cleared for work.

Hands-on experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA is required.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain employee records, eligibility, and rosters within Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Schedule and coordinate required training, including Safety Council, MSHA, OSHA 10/30, Security Passport, NCCER, NCCCO, and site-specific orientations.
Maintain employee certifications, assessments, and training records in FCC.
Run monthly FCC reports to identify upcoming expirations and coordinate required renewals or recertifications.
Assist with onsite new-hire onboarding and ensure required documentation is completed.
Create and maintain employee electronic files in SharePoint, including I-9 documentation, direct deposit forms, training cards, credentials, and certifications.
Submit background checks, run MVRs, coordinate drug screens, and track outstanding employee clearance requirements.
Coordinate weekly Cintas uniform service, including orders, exchanges, replacements, and returns.
Maintain safety-related spreadsheets, reports, rosters, and compliance records.
Communicate with employees, supervisors, training providers, and internal departments regarding missing or expiring requirements.

Required Qualifications

Experience with Alliance Safety Council and DISA.
Experience scheduling industrial safety training and maintaining employee compliance records.
Strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple employees, deadlines, and expiration dates simultaneously.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

FCC or similar training/compliance management system.
Microsoft SharePoint.
Familiarity with TWIC, NCCER, NCCCO, OSHA, MSHA, Security Passport, and industrial site-access requirements.

Position Details

Full-Time | Permanent | Monday-Friday | Onsite | Safety Department
